title: Senior Global Data AI Specialist

Working knowledge of ML and statistics: supervised and unsupervised learning, model validation, regression, time series and hypothesis testing. Experience with ML frameworks such as Scikit-learn and, where relevant, XGBoost, PyTorch or TensorFlow. Experience with automated pipelines and CI/CD, using version control and testing practices, preferably in Azure DevOps or GitHub. Hands-on experience with Snowflake AI/ML tools (Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, AI Functions) and Snowflake connectors.
